Timber Hill Has Boosted Its Morgan Stanley (MS) Stake by $4.68 Million; As Bank Amer (BAC) Market Valuation Declined, Bingham Osborn & Scarborough Upped Its Stake 
April 21, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers 
Timber Hill Llc increased its stake in Morgan Stanley (MS) by 501.11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Timber Hill Llc bought 89,980 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.82% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 107,936 shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.66M, up from 17,956 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Timber Hill Llc who had been investing in Morgan Stanley for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $96.61B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.44% or $0.24 during the last trading session, reaching $54.46. About 10.18M shares traded or 1.34% up from the average. Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) has risen 27.83% since April 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.28% the S&P500.
